title: Atlas zone content
description: One file per cluster-1 zone: why a player walks in, what threatens them, what they carry out, and what they remember seeing. The authority on where a zone is (id, levelBand, polygon) is the resolved world — content/world/resolved/*.json, the committed join regenerated by scripts/check_resolved.mjs --write — and is never written back to. Shape only: the floors, the kebab-case ids, the hazard effect enum and the resource kind enum are gate rules Z3/Z4/Z5/Z7 in scripts/check_content.mjs, because a schema-invalid document never reaches them. I-060. PLAN E TASK 9: a record joins the world by `region` (a fabric region id) and declares `survey`. The `survey` enum DELIBERATELY allows `reported` here even though a committed record on reported ground is a gate FAILURE: banning it in the schema would make that Z2 rule unreachable dead code, the same reachability discipline the floors, the kebab ids and the two enums already follow.
